```{=html}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Events Schedule - Fixed</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
            background: #f8f9fa;
            padding: 20px;
        }
        .toggle-btn {
            padding: 8px 16px;
            border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            color: white;
            border-radius: 6px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .toggle-btn.active {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
            border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
        }

        .schedule-container {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 12px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .schedule-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 20px;
            background: #343a40;
            color: white;
        }

        .schedule-header h1 {
            color: white;
            margin: 0;
        }

        /* Schedule layout */
        .schedule-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 80px repeat(4, 1fr);
            background: #e9ecef;
            gap: 1px;
        }

        .schedule-layout.weekend {
            grid-template-columns: 80px repeat(2, 1fr);
        }

        /* Headers */
        .day-header {
            background: #000000;
            color: white;
            padding: 15px 10px;
            text-align: center;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* Time column */
        .time-column {
            background: #f8f9fa;
            border-right: 1px solid #dee2e6;
        }

        .time-slot {
            height: 40px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #6c757d;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #e9ecef;
        }

        /* Day columns with relative positioning */
        .day-column {
            background: white;
            position: relative;
            min-height: 320px; /* 8 slots * 40px */
        }

        /* Event cards with absolute positioning */
        .event-card {
            position: absolute;
            left: 4px;
            right: 4px;
            background: #6c757d;
            color: white;
            padding: 6px 10px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-size: 0.8em;
            font-weight: 500;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            text-align: center;
            overflow: hidden;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        /* For long events like field trips, align text to top */
        .event-card.field-trip {
            align-items: flex-start;
            padding-top: 12px;
        }

        .event-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
            z-index: 10;
        }

        .event-card.architecture {
            background: #495057;
        }

        .event-card.social {
            background: #6c757d;
        }

        .event-card.tour {
            background: #868e96;
        }

        .event-card.field-trip {
            background: #adb5bd;
        }

        .event-card.tram {
            background: #ced4da;
            color: #212529;
        }

        /* Multiple concurrent events */
        .event-card.concurrent-2 {
            width: calc(50% - 6px);
        }

        .event-card.concurrent-3 {
            width: calc(33.33% - 6px);
        }

        .event-card.concurrent-4 {
            width: calc(25% - 6px);
        }

        .event-card.pos-0 { left: 4px; }
        .event-card.pos-1 { left: calc(25% + 2px); }
        .event-card.pos-2 { left: calc(50% + 2px); }
        .event-card.pos-3 { left: calc(75% + 2px); }

        /* Weekend layout has longer time range */
        .day-column.weekend {
            min-height: 1040px; /* 26 slots * 40px */
        }

        .event-tooltip {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 100%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            background: white;
            border: 1px solid #ddd;
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 20px;
            box-shadow: 0 12px 35px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
            z-index: 1000;
            width: 350px;
            opacity: 0;
            visibility: hidden;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .event-card:hover .event-tooltip {
            opacity: 1;
            visibility: visible;
            pointer-events: auto;
        }

        .tooltip-title {
            font-weight: 600;
            color: #2d3436;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            font-size: 1.1em;
        }

        .tooltip-category {
            color: #636e72;
            font-size: 1em;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .tooltip-description {
            color: #636e72;
            font-size: 1em;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .thumbnail-view {
            display: none;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
            gap: 20px;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .thumbnail-view.active {
            display: grid;
        }
        .thumbnail-card {
            border: 1px solid #ccc;
            border-radius: 10px;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-align: center;
            background: #fff;
            transition: transform 0.2s ease;
        }

        .thumbnail-card:hover {
            transform: scale(1.03);
        }

        .thumbnail-card a {
            display: block;
            text-decoration: none;
            color: inherit;
        }

        .thumbnail-card a:hover {
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .thumbnail-card img {
            width: 100%;
            height: 180px;
            object-fit: cover;
        }

        .caption {
            padding: 10px;
        }

        .caption h3 {
            font-size: 1.2em;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin: 0 0 0.2em 0;
        }

        .caption .event-category {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #666;
            margin: 0 0 0.5em 0;
        }

        .caption .writeup {
            font-size: 0.95em;
            color: #444;
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .schedule-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 60px 1fr;
                font-size: 0.8em;
            }
            
            .event-tooltip {
                width: 280px;
                left: 0;
                transform: none;
                bottom: 100%;
                margin-bottom: 10px;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

    <script>
    function toggleToSchedule() {
    document.getElementById('scheduleView').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('thumbnailView').style.display = 'none';
    
    document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-btn')[0].classList.add('active');
    document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-btn')[1].classList.remove('active');
}

function toggleToThumbnails() {
    document.getElementById('scheduleView').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('thumbnailView').style.display = 'grid';
    
    document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-btn')[0].classList.remove('active');
    document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-btn')[1].classList.add('active');
}

function showThumbnails() {
    document.getElementById('scheduleView').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('thumbnailView').classList.add('active');
    document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-btn')[0].classList.remove('active');
    document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-btn')[1].classList.add('active');
}
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        // Calculate and set positions dynamically
        const timeSlotHeight = 40; // pixels per 30-minute slot
        
        function timeToMinutes(timeStr) {
            const [hours, minutes] = timeStr.split(':').map(Number);
            return hours * 60 + minutes;
        }
        
        function calculatePosition(startTime, baseTime) {
            const startMinutes = timeToMinutes(startTime);
            const baseMinutes = timeToMinutes(baseTime);
            const diffMinutes = startMinutes - baseMinutes;
            return (diffMinutes / 30) * timeSlotHeight;
        }
        
        function calculateHeight(startTime, endTime) {
            const startMinutes = timeToMinutes(startTime);
            const endMinutes = timeToMinutes(endTime);
            const durationMinutes = endMinutes - startMinutes;
            return (durationMinutes / 30) * timeSlotHeight;
        }
        
        // Process all day columns
        document.querySelectorAll('.day-column').forEach(column => {
            const isWeekend = column.classList.contains('weekend');
            const baseTime = isWeekend ? '8:30' : '18:00';
            
            column.querySelectorAll('.event-card[data-start][data-end]').forEach(event => {
                const startTime = event.getAttribute('data-start');
                const endTime = event.getAttribute('data-end');
                
                if (!event.style.top) {
                    event.style.top = calculatePosition(startTime, baseTime) + 'px';
                }
                if (!event.style.height) {
                    event.style.height = calculateHeight(startTime, endTime) + 'px';
                }
            });
        });
    });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```
